input.explanation: No. The whole fix is inside this repository. `src/io_shop/visits.py` now caps the in-process visit store and evicts the least recently seen shoppers, without changing any function's signature. Its only caller, `src/io_shop/account_page.py`, needs no change. Nothing outside the repository has to change for the store to stop growing without limit. One thing it can't do is free memory already used by a process that's running the old code; that process still needs the new version deployed.
